title: Exec Resonance Brief & Initiative Gate Playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: This ticket delivers a concise, repeatable "resonance" brief and decision playbook for monthly and quarterly executive readouts. The goal is to reduce preparation churn across PM/Eng/Design by standardizing what we present, how we score initiative health (Signal Fidelity Score), and the exact gating language for investment, defer, or kill decisions. Unlike prior readouts that focused on slides, this artifact prioritizes a two-page executive brief + evidence appendix + explicit ask lanes (Fund / Defer / Sunset) and a compact escalation guideline for runtime or Dedicated capacity risks. Deliverables: 1) one-page 'Resonance Brief' template with mandatory fields and examples, 2) Initiative Gate rubric + scoring spreadsheet, 3) facilitator checklist and runbook for the 30-minute exec sync, 4) mapping of readout outputs to Linear follow-ups (automated templates), 5) Confluence page and Drive folder with canonical artifacts and a GitHub PR template for post-readout action items.
acceptance_criteria: Resonance Brief template published under Confluence path /platform/roadmaps/exec-resonance-brief
Gate rubric implemented as shared Google Sheet and linked from Confluence
At least two pilot readouts run with cross-functional attendees and capture feedback
Linear follow-up templates created and validated by Eng and Design leads
Readout facilitator guide reviewed and signed off by Head of Product and Head of Eng
agenda: 0-5m: One-line status and key metric (Signal Fidelity Score)
5-12m: Initiative ask lane (Fund / Defer / Sunset) with supporting evidence
12-20m: Risk callouts (capacity, security/compliance, customer impact) and mitigations
20-28m: Decision / vote and explicit owner + timeline for action
28-30m: Quick retro on meeting cadence and any gating disagreements
